title: Machine simulation labels
statement: For a Boolean nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, the label type is generated by the rejection and acceptance labels; labels for length scanning and incrementing; and parameterized labels for the prefix, copying, counting, decrementing, simulation, and input-processing routines. Its constructors also include labels indexed by states or configurations of $N$, finite register indices, Boolean flags, and the comparison-phase tags.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a Boolean nondeterministic Turing machine
